opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Awards vary according to project but will only exceptionally exceed £6,000 and will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000. Travel up to £2,000/£2,500 per person; PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000; Japan office up to ¥300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications not accepted from individuals for personal projects. UK projects apply to UK office, Japan projects to Japan office.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring people in the UK and Japan together, deepening mutual understanding and encouraging exchange of ideas or expertise. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/visits/exchange.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Up to £10,000; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK. Applicants should normally show an existing research record; consideration also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Preference to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or to contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs.
